title: Sibling Conspiracy
next_chapter_hook: As the two were plotting, a dark purple transmission talisman burst through the window. Ye Qing's urgent voice rang through the secret chamber: "Chen Ji! Ling Yuan is surrounded by the three great护法 of the Demonic Path at Qingyun Gorge—life and death on a razor's edge—come quickly!"

text.content: In the secret chamber, flickering candlelight cast Chen Ji and Chen Nian's shadows on the mottled walls, like an ink wash painting. Chen Ji listened quietly to his sister's words, his expression unchanged, only his fingers hanging at his side curling slightly, joints turning white. He didn't immediately speak, but slowly shifted his gaze toward the heavy night outside the window, as if contemplating, or suppressing something. After a long while, he spoke softly: "Rewriting Heavenly Fate... what grandiose ambition." His tone was flat as if discussing today's weather, only those who knew him well could hear the undercurrents churning beneath that calm surface.

dialogue.content: "Brother, what you saw in the Forbidden Grounds... is that related to this too?"

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, candlelight dancing in his deep eyes, reflecting an ambiguous light and shadow. He walked slowly toward Chen Nian, stopping before her, reaching up to gently brush away the loose hair at her temple, his gesture tender unlike his usual calculating self. "I've seen things far beyond what you can imagine." His voice was low, carrying a hint of exhaustion he himself wasn't aware of. "But some things, seeing them isn't necessarily a good thing. Nian Nian, you shouldn't have come back." He paused, his Adam's apple moved slightly, as if words were stuck in his throat, finally only becoming a barely audible sigh.

dialogue.content: "Shouldn't come back? Brother, you've been carrying this alone for so many years. As your sister, should I just survive in the shadows?"

text.content: Chen Nian's eyes reddened slightly, but she held back her tears. Taken away by the Holy Sect since childhood, through those dark and sunless days, the only thought sustaining her was finding her brother, telling him in person that she was alive, that she still remembered that warm afternoon when he carried her through the streets as a child to buy sugar-coated hawthorns. "All these years in the Holy Sect, every day I wondered if you thought I was dead." She raised her head, her gaze burning as she stared directly at Chen Ji. "Brother, I'm no longer the little girl who needed your protection back then."

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Nian's persistence, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: After a moment of silence, Chen Ji finally let go of his obsession, acknowledged that his sister had grown up, and chose to respect her choice
choices.visible_cost: Losing the peace of mind from controlling the overall situation alone
choices.visible_reward: The siblings truly fighting side by side, trust greatly increased
choices.risk_hint: Having to divert attention to protect sister's safety in battle

dialogue.content: "Very well. Since Nian Nian insists... then we shall do this together."

choices.text: Persist in having her stay behind the scenes
choices.description: Chen Ji assumed the authority of an elder brother, demanding Chen Nian provide intelligence support from behind the scenes rather than personally risking danger
choices.visible_reward: Protect sister's safety and maintain a safer strategic position
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may develop resistance, affecting subsequent cooperation

dialogue.content: "Brother! You're always like this, carrying everything yourself... Do you think I'm just a burden?"

text.content: The two siblings stood facing each other, a subtle tension filling the air. Outside the window, the night wind suddenly rose, making the candlelight flicker violently, casting fluctuating shadows on Chen Nian's face. She took a deep breath and slowly drew an ancient jade pendant from her bosom. The pendant was deep blue throughout, with flowing light seeming to move within, faintly emanating an aura similar to the fragment in Chen Ji's possession. "Brother, this is the Dragon Vein Fragment I've condensed over the years by secretly learning Holy Sect techniques." She held the jade pendant in her palm. "The Holy Sect people don't know, but I've already been able to sense where the other fragment is located—that's where the complete Tianji Record is hidden."

dialogue.content: "Are you insane? The Dragon Vein Fragment is connected to your soul—if you remove it..."

text.content: Chen Ji's words cut off abruptly—he of course knew what the price would be. The moment the Dragon Vein Fragment was removed, the soul would surely suffer severe damage, at best causing cultivation regression, at worst destroying the foundation entirely. His gaze fell on Chen Nian's pale complexion, then shifted to the jade pendant with its flowing dark light in her hand, an ache stirring in some corner of his heart. This foolish girl, for this moment, how long had she been plotting in secret? His lips pressed into a thin line. After a long while, he spoke heavily: "What you've told me... does the Holy Sect know?"

dialogue.content: "Not for now. But the Emperor and the Holy Sect have already noticed my unusual movements, which is why they're rushing to conduct that ritual. Brother, the imperial court isn't monolithic—three major sects are watching eagerly, and the Demonic Path is stirring... this is our opportunity."

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji integrate this intelligence and formulate the next plan?

choices.text: First obtain the Tianji Record, then destroy the Emperor
choices.description: Utilize Chen Nian's Dragon Vein sensing ability to first find the complete Tianji Record and enhance strength, then scheme against the Emperor
choices.visible_cost: Need to venture into the unknown Forbidden Grounds
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete Tianji Record, strength soars dramatically
choices.risk_hint: The Forbidden Grounds may contain traps laid by the Emperor

text.content: Good, I shall follow your words. But before that, you must first heal your wounds. The matter of the Dragon Vein fragment... let's discuss it later.

choices.text: Use the Emperor's ritual for a decisive countermeasure
choices.description: Strike at the critical moment of the Emperor's ritual, destroying the ceremony while weakening the imperial dynasty and Holy Sect
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise timing, with extremely low margin for error
choices.visible_reward: Kill two birds with one stone, both stopping the Emperor and potentially acquiring Dragon Vein power
choices.risk_hint: The ritual site will surely be a dragon's pool and tiger's den

text.content: The Emperor wants to rewrite Heavenly Fate... Hmph, then let him witness what it truly means to have fate on one's side.

choices.text: Contact the Demonic Path Saint for a three-way chess game
choices.description: Establish a secret alliance with the Demonic Path through Ye Qing, using their blade to kill, letting the imperial dynasty and Holy Sect destroy each other
choices.visible_cost: May invite wolves into the house, the Demonic Path cannot necessarily be trusted
choices.visible_reward: Obtain powerful external allies while dispersing enemy attention
choices.risk_hint: The situation may spiral out of control after the Demonic Path's involvement

dialogue.content: Brother, do you trust the people of the Demonic Path?

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, candlelight sketching a slender silhouette against his back. After contemplating silently for a moment, he finally revealed a faint smile, carrying a warmth absent for far too long. 'You've grown up, Niannian.' He walked slowly to the window and pushed it open, night wind carrying the pine song from distant mountains flooding into the secret chamber. 'All these years I have been positioning myself across the world, seemingly calculating flawlessly, yet in truth... one hand clapping makes no sound.' He turned around, gaze falling upon Chen Nian. 'With your words, I know this chess game has yet to reach its conclusion.'

dialogue.content: Brother, that Mo Xiansheng you mentioned... can he really be trusted? He's merely a remnant soul, does he really know all the secrets of the Tianji Record?

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's lips curved slightly, yet his smile was profound. 'Trustworthy?' He shook his head. 'Niannian, in this world, no one is absolutely trustworthy. Mo Xiansheng, Ling Yuan, even heaven itself...' His gaze deepened, as if piercing through this small secret chamber to gaze at a more distant void. 'What matters is never whether they can be trusted, but whether I can squeeze their value dry before they betray me.' His tone was calm as water, yet Chen Nian felt a chill creep up her spine. This was her brother—with that gentle face, what a cold and ruthless heart he concealed?

choice.prompt: After Chen Ji and his sister had an in-depth conversation, should he reveal more about the Tianji Record's secrets?

choices.text: Honestly tell about the price of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Tell Chen Nian that each use of the Tianji Record consumes Heavenly Fate Value, along with fate's deadly backlash
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian might act rashly due to worry
choices.visible_reward: Remove barriers, siblings truly opening up to each other
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian might try to stop Chen Ji from using the Tianji Record

dialogue.content: Brother! Why didn't you tell me sooner!

choices.description: Tell Chen Nian about the abilities of the Tianji Record, but omit the fatal flaws such as Heavenly Fate consumption
choices.visible_cost: Concealment may lead to a trust crisis in the future
choices.visible_reward: Protect my younger sister from being burdened by the secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: At critical moments, Chen Nian might make misjudgments due to lack of knowledge

text.content: The Tianji Record is powerful, but it has its limitations. Nian Nian, you only need to know that as long as I am here, no one can harm you in the slightest.

The night wind suddenly turned bitter cold, and the candle flame in the secret chamber abruptly dimmed. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly as he sensed a familiar yet strange aura breaking through the air. It was the dark purple Spiritual Light unique to the Demonic Path—Ye Qing's transmission talisman. With a gentle lift of his fingers, the purple light settled steadily into his palm. As the talisman burned, Ye Qing's urgent and tense voice exploded within the secret chamber: "Chen Ji! Ling Yuan is surrounded by the three great protectors of the Demonic Path at Qingyun Gorge, on the brink of life and death—come quickly!" The talisman burned away, ashes falling softly, and Chen Ji's eyes sharply contracted. Ling Yuan... that old sect master who appeared to shelter him while harboring treacherous intentions, was now truly on the verge of death?

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan? Brother, isn't he someone you've always been wary of? Why save him?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze profound as he looked toward the window, countless thoughts racing through his mind. Ling Yuan, the old sect master of Tianqing Sect, his sworn enemy, yet also a crucial piece in this chess game. If he died now, the schemes behind the scenes, those truths yet to be uncovered... would all sink into the abyss along with him. Moreover, if Ling Yuan died at the hands of the Demonic Path, Tianqing Sect and the Demonic Path would inevitably break all ties, and the entire landscape of the cultivation world would be thoroughly disrupted. He slowly turned to face Chen Nian, saying: "The chess game is not yet finished; the pieces cannot die." His voice was low and calm, "Nian Nian, you just said you wanted to fight side by side with me—now, I may need to show you what it means to survive amidst chaos."

dialogue.content: Brother, tell me what to do, I'll follow your lead.

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at the light in his sister's eyes, an indescribable emotion surging in his heart. After more than a decade of separation and reunion, she chose to stand by his side without a single complaint, stepping into this chaotic world alongside him. He stepped forward, gently placing his hand on Chen Nian's shoulder, the warmth of his palm seeping through the thin fabric. "Nian Nian, remember tonight's words." His voice suddenly turned gentle, shedding its usual coldness and calculation, "No matter what happens in the future, brother will always protect you. This time—we are together." As the words fell, the candlelight in the secret chamber seemed to burn brighter. Chen Nian's eyes glistened with a faint redness as she nodded vigorously, carving that fervent promise deep into her heart. Beyond the window, the night was as dark as ink, and distant rumblings of thunder echoed—toward Qingyun Gorge, a storm capable of shaking the world was brewing. And Chen Ji had already set foot on a new journey.
